title: Two current backend sources are joined to stale PROJECT_INDEX hashes
observed_behavior: Exact current-source joins show that PROJECT_INDEX records older source_hash values for the application facade and priority-export implementation. The current reviewed SHA-256 values are f888739bd9a1b4ccf32ccc7d7a9b8ecbb035eb5f5455484903e6df129bd83cd6 and 946a38a817de14c3d11cf8841b7b694271ec2d9f4414b25c43a5b8620e6411b6, while PROJECT_INDEX records 706d83e97a953b3c80ab4eb4c98c5cebc2c3c80974b0d3778e09a52b7df6ac6c and 873b55bb95794ee391e2021766b44505d1737c213369d09d93ae60ec7f09a783 respectively.
expected_invariant: Generated navigation used for ownership, dependency, symbol, and test selection must bind to the same exact source bytes as the semantic review, or the stale path relationship must remain explicitly finding-backed until regeneration.
root_cause: The two source files changed after the last PROJECT_INDEX generation, and the generated navigation set was not refreshed atomically with the current source snapshot.
failure_scenario: An agent follows the mandatory generated-navigation workflow and scopes review or validation from obsolete dependency/test metadata even though the semantic review is attached to newer source bytes.
evidence: Current build_rows reports project_index_present=true and project_index_hash_matches=false for both locations.
The current worktree SHA-256 values match current HEAD 2494bea1fd6280f41bec3f56e21b8bd98dd20829 and the current-head delta manifest.
Direct PROJECT_INDEX parsing recovered the exact older source_hash values and associated-test/public-symbol metadata for both paths.
AUDIT-FIND-COV-001 already establishes the repository-wide non-atomic generated-context root cause; this finding supplies the exact path-local locations required by strict review reconciliation.
affected_flows: ownership, dependency, symbol, and associated-test lookup
existing_safeguards: PROJECT_INDEX stores source hashes, generator check modes expose drift, and the repository-audit ledger compares indexed hashes with reviewed bytes.
safeguard_gap: The checked-in PROJECT_INDEX remains stale until the writer-freeze regeneration phase, so consumers can still observe the older metadata.
tests_missing: A settled-writer phase gate that atomically binds source, summaries, and PROJECT_INDEX hashes before review publication.
recommended_remediation: After concurrent writers quiesce, regenerate summaries first and PROJECT_INDEX/dependency navigation second, rerun all generated-context check modes, and rebind the final coverage matrix to the settled hashes.
remediation_risk: Low for deterministic generated navigation; regeneration must preserve concurrent user work and wait for the audit writer freeze.
validation_rung: Generated-context check modes, exact source-summary-PROJECT_INDEX hash joins, and repository-audit current-content validation; representative real-media validation is not required.
prior_audit_relationship: Path-local extension of the already confirmed AUDIT-FIND-COV-001 root cause; these two current source locations were not present in an existing finding fragment.
